purpose: Separate field-relative early-rating geometry from verified lead-seeking and actual early positioning; do not score late pace yet.
threshold_status: Prespecified exploratory engineering cutoffs, not provider-calibrated or fitted probabilities. Report all policies without selecting by outcomes.
prediction_inputs: Separately reviewed historical style when available
excluded_prediction_inputs: Running lines from cards dated after the target
interpretation: Geometry is not a fast/slow pace forecast. Missing independent styles prevent certification of a lone leader or committed speed duel.
validation_primary: First-call positioning of highest-Early horse: top-three rate and normalized early position; report field coverage and tie handling.
validation_secondary: Observed first-call near-lead count (within one length) using cumulative beaten lengths from PP-preview tables; never chart gap-to-next-horse margins.
validation_sources: Previously analyzed Belmont October 17 official chart, where first-call columns and field identity verify
Later running lines from the already analyzed 25-card source pool; evaluation-only and separated from predictions
unknowns: No validated actual-fast/slow tempo labels or pars currently supplied; no claims of fast-pace prediction accuracy. Partial later-line coverage cannot establish an uncontested lead.
